== Ingredients ==
* 4 small [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchini]], halved lengthwise
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] crumbled [[Cookbook:Cornbread (disambiguation)|cornbread]], divided
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], separated
* 1 ½ cups grated [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterey Jack cheese]]
* ⅛ tsp [[Cookbook:Cream of Tartar|cream of tartar]]

== Procedure ==
#Scoop out the column of seeds in zucchini halves using a teaspoon or a grapefruit spoon. Set aside.
#Combine 1 cup cornbread with salt, pepper, egg yolks, and cream cheese. Set aside.
#[[Cookbook:Whipping|Whip]] egg whites to stiff peaks with cream of tartar. Stir in ¼ of the egg whites.
#Gently fold in remaining egg whites. Place enough mixture to fill the column in the zucchini.
#Combine remaining cornbread and Monterrey Jack cheese. Sprinkle over top of each zucchini half.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a 400°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for 30–35 minutes or until browned and bubbly on top. Serve warm.

steps.text: Scoop out the column of seeds in zucchini halves using a teaspoon or a grapefruit spoon. Set aside.
Combine 1 cup cornbread with salt, pepper, egg yolks, and cream cheese. Set aside.
Whip egg whites to stiff peaks with cream of tartar. Stir in ¼ of the egg whites.
